TEXT: [FI] After parting with Kuroneko and Saori, on the way home...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Ah! I just remembered!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What are you raising your voice for? Did you forget something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Not that. Have you completed "SisSis"?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] About that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] What? Don't tell me you haven't played it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] T-That's not it!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Then what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] "SisSis"... It's a great game!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Hmm, so you haven't played it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, look...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I can't believe it. Why haven't you played it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] How long do you think it has been since I lent you "SisSis"?
[FI] N-Not good...
[FI] Looks like I've incurred her wrath...
[FI] If I don't do anything soon...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, I've played "Miyabi's route".

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That route was really great～

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Wasn't that the one I played with you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] L-Look... I'm preparing for entrance exams...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] What's that? I can't believe it. "Rinko-rin's route" is still---

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] --No, never mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Nothing at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] To think you didn't play "SisXSis"...
[FI] Oh?
[FI] I was ready to withstand at least one roundhouse kick but...
[FI] But her reaction is mild...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Anyway, I'll play it properly later...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Shut up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Besides, why haven't you played it? Isn't it normal to go into other routes after completing Miyabi's?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I don't usually play games. You know that, don't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Hah?! That reason is not acceptable!
[FI] I know full well that she won't accept a legitimate claim.
[FI] As usual, Kirino will lose her temper--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ahhh, that...
[FI] It doesn't feel like I can say I didn't.
[FI] I don't think a sound argument can get through to her.
[FI] What could be most suitable to trick her...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] You haven't, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, I played it yesterday.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Lies.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's not a lie!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yesterday, when I came back home, I started "Rinko's route"...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] If you admit that it's a lie right now, I may forgive you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...It's a lie!
[FI] As expected, Kirino's complexion changed in a flash.
[FI] But, strangely, she looks pained; is it my imagination?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So... you're not forgiving me at all...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] What I meant was that I'd forgive your lying.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I won't forgive you for not playing "SisSis" though.
